summary: Publish Nex Core 0.2.9 to the public website and signed APT archive, then independently verify the full ISO, corresponding-source bundle, compliance manifest, both Debian package payloads, release aliases and signed repository metadata. API impact: none.

guide.reason: The release guide now points to the completed 0.2.9 public website and signed APT verification while retaining hosted CI as an open limit.

api.reason: Publishing immutable release files and APT metadata changes no Controller/Core operation, agent command, client-facing endpoint, request, response or authorization rule.

roadmap.reason: This publishes an already implemented release; it does not change the public product milestone scope or feature status.

state.reason: Public release files and APT indexes are distribution outputs, not durable Controller or Core pool state.

verification.method: On 2026-09-17, published both 0.2.9 Debian packages through the existing signed APT publisher and published the ISO, source bundle, compliance manifest and SHA-256 sidecars through the existing atomic download publisher. Full independent HTTPS downloads of all five binary/source/manifest/package payloads matched their recorded SHA-256 values. Both versioned and latest sidecars matched; the manifest bound the ISO and source hashes; gpgv reported a good InRelease signature from the published archive key; Packages contained both 0.2.9 entries and hashes; updates.json advertised 0.2.9; the website service remained active; staging was removed.
